sections: 12.7.7 FDF file structure and field dictionaries
facts: Null-valued dictionary entries are equivalent to absent entries; they do not suppress inherited field values.
Nonterminal fields provide inheritable defaults and have no logical field type of their own.
Common FT/Ff/V/DV and variable-text DA/Q/MaxLen are inheritable; choice Opt/I/TI and RV/DS are not declared inheritable, while checkbox/radio Opt is.
Button V and widget AS identify appearance states; optional indexed button Opt retains separate label data.
Choice multi-selection indices follow option order; I should not be used for single-selection fields.
FDF cross references are optional, objects have generation zero and unique object numbers, incremental updates are forbidden and stream lengths are direct.
FDF contains additional field/option/action/file/appearance instructions beyond a field-value-only profile; those instructions must not be silently applied or discarded as supported behavior.
limitations: The primary XFDF document download was denied by the configured network path. The bounded field/value implementation and independent XML checks do not establish complete XFDF conformance.
Normative facts and synthetic fixtures do not qualify complete data exchange, signature transforms or production behavior.
